pred_ddx.label: Impacted lower left lateral incisor with a possible odontoma

Impacted lower left lateral incisor with: The presence of an unerupted lower left lateral incisor with an associated well-defined radiopaque lesion surrounded by a thin radiolucent halo suggests an odontoma, which is a type of benign tumor that can obstruct tooth eruption.
Compound Odontoma: The presence of a well-defined radiopaque lesion surrounded by a thin radiolucent halo in the mandibular anterior region, obstructing the eruption path of the lower left lateral incisor, is consistent with a compound odontoma. This type of odontogenic tumor is composed of multiple small tooth-like structures and can prevent the eruption of adjacent teeth.
